topic: Original private one-time yield membership and spend-before-move ordering
sourceTrace: Both existing follow-through yield paths read spent membership from CBE_Cortex_ClearYield. The interior path issued doMove/rememberMove before publishing its spent key; exterior selection already recorded its attempt before the final move.
A missing resume yield receipt was interpreted as an empty unspent set. Unknown/mismatched external public state was not bound to an original private producer ledger.

Reserve admission already has a private native-baseline map, while casualty-relief attempts still read/write their public receipt. Their full source serialization/private ownership remains separate unfinished work.
implementation: Fresh visits initialize private yieldReceipt[visitContext,[]] and publish the explicit zero-spent receipt only through current guarded preparation. Resume takes the exact preflight-admitted original receipt, retaining absence as unknown rather than resetting membership.

Follow-through decisions read private yieldReceipt and require current public equality. Missing/malformed private state, a mismatched public mirror, invalid IDs or the existing64-key limit refuse another yield. Unset fields refuse instead of being read as a fresh budget.

Both actual spends recheck the public mirror/current operation, append the original actor key, update the private receipt and publish it before movement. Exterior movement additionally requires the current attempt recorded flag; failed geometry still preserves the existing conservative spent-attempt policy. No deadline, recovery or failed-room budget is renewed.

BuildingFollowJournal version2 has five fields, appending the original typed yield receipt.[] means unknown/malformed, distinct from a valid two-field zero-spent receipt. Normal follow-budget publication remains independent via field3; outgoing capture additionally requires a known two-field yield receipt. Outer capture becomes version9 while retaining fourteen fields.
cost: One private receipt and explicit guarded zero-spent publication at fresh preparation. Existing bounded membership validation plus one public/private comparison per follow-through callback and exact mirror checks per actual spend. Snapshot copies at most64 string keys. No new worker, scan, query, timer, route or native command. Actual5percent median/10percent p95 remains unmeasured.
limits: Attempt membership is not proof that the native command moved or that an exit/watch is physically held. Recording before issue is conservative and cannot grant arrival or room visits.

Missing yield receipt on resume disables the optional yield and prevents a complete outgoing capture; it does not invent a zero-spent proof. Full authenticated delivery/acknowledgement remains required.

Reserve admission and casualty-relief source components/private ownership remain incomplete, as do other actor native/settings/interruption/retirement and full producer registration/seal/replay/native readiness.
Actual normal/HC/Zeus migration, repeated flow/casualty behaviour, balance and performance remain unverified; audits paused.
